text:
Sofia - People Ops: Thanks everyone — opening this post-all-hands Q&A thread focused on leveling, promotions, comp bands, and benefits. I'll be answering live here. Please keep questions concise; if you need one-on-one, DM. Reviews close next Friday 11:59pm PT.
Amit - CEO: Quick note — promotions should prioritize impact and cross-team influence. No hard quota from execs this cycle. 
Jordan - Eng Manager: For ICs moving to Senior, are there examples we can share of expected scope? 😅
Sofia - People Ops: Yes, sharing the leveling rubric: https://intranet.redwood/leveling/rubric (see 'IC expectations' section). Also attaching examples in the doc.
Priya - People Ops: Calibration will happen the following week. Managers: please submit promotion packets by EOD Monday so we have time to review.
Liam: Is there a formal process for spot bonuses if someone shipped a huge perf win mid-cycle?
Sofia - People Ops: Good Q — spot bonuses are available for exceptional contributions outside review cycle. Submit via the 'Recognition' form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/spot-bonus
Evelyn: Any change to comp bands or refresh timing this year?
Amit - CEO: We're doing a targeted comp refresh for roles where market delta >10%. Expect outreach from Priya's team if you're impacted.
hr-bot: Reminder: 2 days left to complete self-evals. https://intranet.redwood/hr/self-eval
Jordan - Eng Manager: For folks who missed last cycle feedback, can we request retroactive consideration?
Sofia - People Ops: If it's a recent miss (last 3 months), yes — open a ticket to people-ops and we'll advise. For older cases, we recommend normal review cycle.
Priya - People Ops: Also: parental leave top-ups and extended benefits info are in Benefits > 2026 updates. Link: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/2026
Liam: TIA! Also: any guidance on leveling for ICs who do a lot of cross-functional work but limited direct reports?
Sofia - People Ops: Cross-functional impact is definitely part of the rubric. Focus evidence on scope, outcomes, and influencing product/roadmap.
Jordan - Eng Manager: Thanks — will gather examples and submit packet.
Sofia - People Ops: I'll summarize answers and post a short FAQ doc after we wrap. Ping me if you want an offline chat. :heart:
